text:
sam: Hey team — kicking off AtlasAI onboarding. First meeting tomorrow 11:00 AM PT. Goals: confirm dataset ingestion, low-latency dev API, SLOs, and QBR readiness. @anya @mike please confirm stakeholders and high-risk items. Thanks :wave:
anya: Thanks! Stakeholders: Priya (Eng), Marcos (ML infra), Dana (Product), Aaron (Security). Success criteria: 1) 1k qps sustained on dev workload w/ p95 < 300ms, 2) model drift detection in place, 3) docs + 2 enablement sessions for devs. I'll own enablement. :+1:
mike: I'll take infra ramp and capacity sizing. Need sample traffic profile from Priya. Can someone share ETA on data transfer (SFTP vs direct)?
sam: Priya said SFTP by next Tue. Risk: renewal flagged — they requested strict logging retention & SOC2 scoping. Tagging @leila to coordinate contract changes.
leila: Noted. I'll surface retention options and escalate to legal if needed. Also creating enablement hub in docs.redwood.link/atlasai (will share).
jordan: For success metrics - propose we track adoption events + 30-day dev MAU. Can we add a heatmap of API error sources? ops-bot will wire up alerts.
ops-bot: Onboarding kickoff created for AtlasAI. Meeting scheduled: 2024-06-05 11:00 PT. Link: https://cal.link/meet/atlasai-kickoff :calendar:
mike: Quick tech note — recommending quantized-small model variant for dev until dedicated GPUs are provisioned. Saves ~45% cost. Will prepare benchmark.
anya: Enablement plan (high level): Week 0 - kickoff + access. Week 1 - integration workshop (code + SDK). Week 2 - perf tuning + SLO walk-through. Week 4 - readiness review + handoff. We should capture feedback after each workshop (simple form).
sam: Action items: 1) Priya to provide traffic sample (owner: Priya, due Tue) 2) Mike to post bench results (due Fri) 3) Leila to confirm retention SLAs (due Wed) 4) Anya to draft enablement agenda (due Mon) 5) Jordan to set tracking dashboard (due Thu).
leila: I'll also flag renewal risk score=medium; need to get SOC2 carveouts clarified. Updating the shared sheet: https://sheets.redwood/atlasai-onboard
mike: ack, will add perf numbers to the sheet after bench. Also will include sample curl snippet for quickstart:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"Hello"}'
```
anya: Good. For feedback capture, I suggest one short form per workshop + a quick NPS at 30 days. I'll draft the form. :memo:
sam: Great progress. We'll use this thread for quick async updates. If anything blocks, ping me. :rocket:
